prototypeEvidence.finding: Ranged and melee/support assemblies produced different deterministic winners before content expansion.

configurationsTried.name: balanced
configurationsTried.role: Light blade/repair, heavy shield/caster, spider caster/battery
configurationsTried.finding: Wins the first three encounters but needs adaptation later.

configurationsTried.name: bulwark
configurationsTried.finding: Strong into ranged pressure; can force timeout tiebreaks against repair teams.

configurationsTried.name: skirmish
configurationsTried.finding: Fast and decisive in some matchups, fragile into heavy pressure.

configurationsTried.name: rangedWall
configurationsTried.role: Shield/armor wall, repair caster and spider mortar
configurationsTried.finding: Carries encounters four and five; loses the finale without tactical adaptation.

configurationsTried.name: hammerPair
configurationsTried.finding: Initially dominated every side-swapped duel; hammer cadence/damage adjusted to 2.8 s/22.

configurationsTried.name: finalCounter
configurationsTried.role: Shield wall, repair caster, sensor/boost spider
configurationsTried.finding: Wins the finale after focusing Oracle and overloading the wall caster.

legacyPreflight.reason: The legacy standalone-HTML check rejects every local src/href resource; the hosted multi-file browser recipe is required for JS and GLB.

limitations: Ranged attacks use grid distance, not line-of-sight raycasts.
Browser verification covers desktop and a narrow mobile viewport, not a physical-device/GPU matrix.
The legacy check-local static-web-v1 command does not support this multi-file GLB game; export validation uses the hosted browser validator instead.
